changeset.li: Update to 1.38.0, the version in Debian Forky and in Alpine, with Alpine's patches and those security fixes from Debian that Alpine does not have
Use Alpine's configuration, with PAM and SELinux switched on
Drop the busybox-*-symlinks packages. A trigger of the busybox package creates the links for all applets that no other installed package provides, as in Alpine
New package busybox-binsh with the link /bin/sh
New package busybox-ssl-client with Alpine's helper for wget and https
New package busybox-suid with Alpine's bbsuid, the busybox binary itself is not setuid
Use latest upstream with Alpine Linux patches
Upgrade to version from Debian Bullseye
Upgrade to latest version from Debian Buster.
Adaptation of Debian sources for Bolt OS
